pages.title: Opening the screen
text: Press K by default; rebind it under Options -> Controls.
The screen is a plain custom Screen and does not touch your inventory. It requests a fresh snapshot from the server on open and shows "Syncing..." until it arrives.

pages.title: Layout
text: The header shows your current level and available points. The body is 26 rows: 13 stats x 2 modes (flat / percent).
Each row has five columns: stat name, mode, invested points, current contribution and the action buttons. There are three buttons: -1, +1 and +10.
Scroll with the mouse wheel; the "Respec (free)" button at the bottom refunds every point at once.

If the stat has been truncated by a ceiling - the vanilla attribute range, or one of this mod's functional caps such as 100% critical chance - a "!" marker appears at the start of the row, meaning further points do nothing. With an attribute-range mod installed that marker appears much later.

pages.title: Tooltips
text: Hovering a row shows the stat and mode, the invested points and the current contribution.

Only the two damage reduction lines are saturating; they additionally show how much of the asymptote you already hold, roughly how many more points buy another 5%, and the asymptote itself (never reached). Linear rows show none of that.
Percent rows show their basis: TOTAL scales base + equipment + your flat points, while DESIGN_BASELINE converts the percentage into a fixed amount on top of the design reference B_ref.

pages.title: Server validation and feedback
text: Every allocation is re-validated on the server. Possible replies: not enough points, that line is disabled, that line is already at its point cap, too many requests, respec on cooldown.
The client-side number is only a display; the server is always the authority.
